paper_title: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Abusive Language Detection in Low-Resource   Settings
caption: : Task-wise Class Distributions
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of classes across different tasks, as labeled in the study. The chart displays a total of 15 categories, arranged in a circular layout. The categories are labeled as: Positive (orange), Mixed (light blue), Negative (teal), Neutral (tan), Political (light purple), Religious (green), Racial (dark blue), Sexist (light green), Abusive (pink), Other (light gray), Not Abusive (yellow), TiALD (gold), Negative (teal), Mixed (light blue), and Negative (teal).  The slices are colored in distinguishable hues, and percentage labels are provided within each segment. The structure of the chart arranges slices in a descending order based on their proportional size. A legend is not present, but the labels within the slices provide the category names.
